    The Euler form computes Hom - Ext¹ in projective dimension one #

    The dimension vector of A is the vector of row sums of the Cartan matrix (dimv_self), and a free module Aⁿ has n times that dimension vector. For a module Z with a free presentation 0 → Aⁿ¹ → Aⁿ⁰ → Z → 0, dim Z = (n₀ - n₁) dim A, so ⟨dim Z, dim W⟩ = dim Hom(Z, W) - dim Ext¹(Z, W) (euler_eq_hom_sub_ext1).
